evals.prompt: I'm building a Vue app with shadcn-vue. Create a settings form component with fields for: full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push notifications as switch toggles). Add validation using vee-validate and zod.
evals.expected_output: A Vue SFC using <script setup>, Label + Input for text fields, Switch for toggles, vee-validate for form handling, gap-* spacing, and semantic colors.
expectations: Uses Label and Input components from shadcn-vue for form fields
Uses Switch for independent on/off notification toggles
Uses vee-validate with zod schema for validation
Uses gap-* (e.g. gap-4, gap-6) instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses semantic color tokens (e.g. bg-background, text-muted-foreground, text-destructive) instead of raw colors

evals.prompt: Create a dialog component for editing a user profile. It should have the user's avatar at the top, input fields for name and bio, and Save/Cancel buttons. Using shadcn-vue with lucide-vue-next icons.
evals.expected_output: A Vue SFC with DialogTitle, Avatar+AvatarFallback, lucide-vue-next icon imports, proper Dialog composition.
expectations: Includes DialogTitle for accessibility (visible or with sr-only class)
Uses <script setup> pattern with proper TypeScript
Uses full Dialog composition (DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription)
Uses gap-* instead of space-y-* for spacing

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard component that shows 4 stat cards in a grid. Each card has a title, large number, percentage change badge, and a loading skeleton state. Using shadcn-vue.
evals.expected_output: A Vue SFC with full Card composition, Skeleton for loading, Badge for changes, semantic colors, gap-* spacing.
expectations: Uses full Card composition with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent (not dumping everything into CardContent)
Uses Skeleton component for loading placeholders instead of custom animate-pulse divs
Uses Badge component for percentage change instead of custom styled spans
Uses semantic color tokens instead of raw color values like bg-green-500 or text-red-600
Uses gap-* instead of space-y-* or space-x-* for spacing
Uses size-* when width and height are equal instead of separate w-* h-*
